title: JWT attack matrix
preconditions: the verification behavior can be observed
steps: Decode header/payload; note `alg`, `kid`, `jku`, `x5u`, `iss`, `aud`, and the claim that gates the flag.
Try `alg:none` (empty signature) and algorithm confusion: RS256 public key used as HS256 secret.
Crack a weak HMAC secret with `hashcat -m 16500 jwt.txt wordlist`; re-sign with the recovered key.
Test `kid` path traversal/SQLi, `jku`/`x5u` pointing at an attacker-controlled JWKS, and claim/audience abuse.
Verify the server accepts the forged token with one request; do not spray tokens.
falsifier: The library pins the algorithm, rejects `none`, validates `kid`/`jku`, and the secret is strong.
